issue_description: Ship Date - Order Date ranges ~900-1640 days across the ENTIRE dataset and does not vary meaningfully by Ship Mode (Same Day mean ~1333 days vs Standard Class ~1314 days). This is inconsistent with real shipping lead times and indicates Ship Date was generated/shifted independently of the rest of the record (e.g. a synthetic dataset). The raw field is retained for transparency but is NOT treated as a valid real-world delivery-duration signal. The model target used downstream is a de-trended relative index, documented in prediction_engine.py.
